scientific_integrity: Ordinary nonequivariant homotopy type is previously known and is not represented as new. Finite checks supplement the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Orbifold statement applies to the explicitly invariant torus core; the original three-dimensional complex has equivariantly homotopy-equivalent quotients, not an asserted orbifold homeomorphism. Possible unindexed equivalent work remains a novelty risk.
title: Pillowcase quotients and integral dihedral actions on cycle-square neighborhood tori
